meta.name: Classica
meta.description:
Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

Shows: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2, Orff: Carmina Burana, Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major, Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2, Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
Available on: Pluto TV
